newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says to suspend, delist AMRE.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says to suspend, delist AMRE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Monday that the trading of AMRE Inc's common stock will be suspended immediately.
It said it will apply with the Securities and Exchange Commission to have the stock delisted.
NYSE said it took the action to suspend trading of AMRE stock because the company no longer meets listing requirements, including the market value of its shares.
The exchange's action follows the company's announcement on January 17 that it had filed for Chapter 11 protection under the fededal bankruptcy law and that it had ceased operations.
AMRE is a Dallas-based direct sale and marketing company for siding, windows, coating and kitchen cabinet products.
